copy_operations.purpose: Keep code, active contracts, schemas, examples, tests and tools in one independently testable tree

installation_sequence: Create a reusable pre-install snapshot through the installed local-first safety controls.
Stage all copy operations privately under the live generator root.
Run the 39-test suite and contract/evidence validators from the staged installed tree.
Verify the existing Stage 6C semantic parity baseline remains PASS.
Record source hashes, installed hashes, test results and snapshot ID in one installation receipt.
Do not upload to Drive until the normal end-of-day publication workflow.

integration_points.action: Emit diadem.engineering.benchmark.v1 and select comparators from preservation_matrix.v1.json
Use future_cache_key with semantic source/recipe fingerprints and a structured spatial-unit ID
Use fingerprint_manifest/fingerprint_lineage and retain logical IDs when transport paths are omitted
Require validated benchmark, corruption, cancellation and fallback records before ADOPT
